projects.title: Order-to-Cash Multi-Agent Pipeline
projects.description: A LangGraph supervisor-agent architecture automating order validation, invoicing, and reconciliation with Azure OpenAI GPT-4o.
achievements: Automated order validation and reconciliation workflows
Built a supervisor-agent pipeline for end-to-end process orchestration
Integrated asynchronous task handling for robust production execution

projects.title: Multi-Agent Incident Response System
projects.description: A multi-agent incident response platform using LLMs and RAG for automated root-cause analysis and mitigation recommendations.
achievements: Built a five-agent pipeline for anomaly detection, log analysis, and mitigation recommendations
Deployed the system end-to-end for production incident triage
Integrated low-latency LLM inference with self-hosted models

projects.title: Knowledge Graph System for Project Management
projects.description: A PMBOK-based knowledge graph using BERT for entity and relation extraction, with semantic retrieval powered by PyTorch and Pinecone.
achievements: Built a knowledge graph for project management concepts and relationships
Used NLP and GNNs to support entity extraction and link prediction
Enabled knowledge retrieval with semantic search

projects.title: Plug&Chat
projects.description: A multi-tenant RAG assistant for per-client knowledge isolation, semantic retrieval, and voice interaction features.
achievements: Built a multi-tenant assistant with isolated client knowledge bases
Integrated voice interaction features into the underlying RAG backend
Exposed RAG and NLP functionality through REST APIs
